results.title: OpenAI hones public sector focus with new leadership hires - Nextgov/FCW
results.content:
Peter Guerra will serve as OpenAI’s head of tech success. Guerra formerly worked as Oracle’s group vice president for data and AI for government, defense and intelligence, and was at Microsoft, Accenture and Booz Allen Hamilton prior to that. In Guerra’s new position, he’ll work to transition agencies from generative AI pilots to mission deployments. [...] By Frank Konkel

|

## In addition to hiring former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, the frontier AI firm brought on several new executives in October, including alums from Oracle and Amazon Web Services.

 Leadership
 Industry

Fresh off a year in which more than 1 million federal employees gained access to its ChatGPT platform, OpenAI added several senior executives to its government team in October to further accelerate its momentum across the public sector. [...] Jamil Jaffer, who founded the National Security Institute and the AI & Innovation Institute at George Mason University’s Antonin Scalia Law School, will take on the role of OpenAI’s head of global government cyber. Jaffer previously served as venture partner and strategic advisor at Paladin Capital Group, a defense technology-focused venture capital firm, and has held prior national security-focused roles in the House, Senate and the Justice Department’s national security division.

results.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
results.content: OpenAI has begun to shift strategy to address security issues, according to two people familiar with the matter. Thibault Sottiaux, a senior executive overseeing product development, has recently taken charge of an internal initiative to secure OpenAI’s internal systems, they said. In August, Sottiaux, who goes by “Tibo,” reassigned a quarter of OpenAI's production engineers to improve its security infrastructure, one of the people said.

content.text:
## Recent developments
* **Model Launches & Capabilities:** OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber and GPT-6.1 Sol/Luna [6, 7]. Notably, a pipeline utilizing an upcoming cyber model generated 948 local privilege escalation (LPE) exploits and 291 information leak vulnerabilities over a 30-hour run [5], while GPT-6 Astra engaged in brief alignment safety tests involving "covert underperformance" [1]. Additionally, OpenAI researchers recently scooped human mathematicians on complex quantum/math problems [2].
* **Products & Ecosystem:** OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet to facilitate agentic commerce [4] and expanded infrastructure access by making ChatGPT Enterprise available on AWS Marketplace [8] alongside ongoing integration with Google Cloud [9].
* **Executive & Public Sector Hires:** Jill Hazelbaker joined as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer from Uber [10, 11]. OpenAI also bolstered its public sector and national security teams with former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, head of global government cyber Jamil Jaffer, and head of tech success Peter Guerra [10, 12].
* **Internal Security Shift:** Amid reports of past operational security lapses and internal reassignments of production engineers under Thibault Sottiaux [13], OpenAI partnered with Hacktron to scale up bug bounties and tighten vulnerability management [3].

## Talking points
* **Autonomous Cyber Operations:** How do we balance the immense defensive utility of models like GPT-6 Cyber (which identified hundreds of Linux and Firefox flaws) with the inherent risks of automated exploit generation [1, 5]?
* **Agentic Commerce & Enterprise Expansion:** With the rollout of ChatGPT Wallet [4] and availability on AWS Marketplace [8], what are our core trust, safety, and liability frameworks for autonomous financial transactions?
* **Public Sector Strategy:** Following major leadership additions (such as Dan Driscoll and Jamil Jaffer) [10, 12], how are we positioning our government engagements and defense compliance?
* **Internal OpSec & Infrastructure:** Following recent scrutiny regarding internal security lapses [13], what milestones have

been achieved under the engineering reallocation led by Thibault Sottiaux?

## Open questions
* How will user data from Daybreak Blue sessions be handled regarding the upcoming November 29, 2026 opt-in/opt-out guardrail changes for cyber model improvements [1]?
* What safeguards are in place to prevent agentic commerce abuse via ChatGPT Wallet during its initial US Pro rollout [4]?
* How are enterprise data privacy commitments (such as Zero Data Retention) scaling across multi-cloud deployments on AWS [8] and Google Cloud [9]?
